# yaml-language-server: $schema=<relative>/<repo>/packages/components/schema/component.schema.json
# Overlay scaffold: a callout pill pointing at the step's target (props.anchor), or a lower third when there is no
# anchor. Pops in, holds, fades out at the end of its duration.
id: acme/badge
version: 0.1.0
kind: overlay
name: Badge
description: A small badge in a corner.
slots:
  text: { type: text, required: true, max_chars: 60, description: The callout text. }
  kicker:
    {
      type: text,
      max_chars: 30,
      description: Small uppercase line before the text.
    }
params:
  type: object
  properties:
    placement:
      {
        type: string,
        enum: [ auto, above, below ],
        default: auto,
        description: Side of the target (auto = above when there is room).
      }
    max_width:
      {
        type: number,
        minimum: 200,
        maximum: 1200,
        default: 560,
        description: Widest pill in design px.
      }
tokens: [ colors.accent, colors.text, colors.paper, fonts.body ]
duration: { default: 2.5, min: 0.8, max: 30 }
variants: [ landscape, vertical ]
preview:
  slots: { text: Totals update as you type, kicker: Live }
  at: [ 0.8 ]

Usage: retake plan [options] <project> <run>

                     raw, split or pip (multi-page scenes) or a layout component

  --square           the square 1:1 variant (1080×1080, reframed on the cursor

  -h, --help         display help for command

export-capture --help.out:
Usage: retake export-capture [options] <project> <run>

export a run raw for another editing tool: a clip per scene (loads cut), MP4 or
ProRes, 30/60 fps, cursor baked/none/layer, FCPXML/EDL/OTIO/CSV markers,
manifest

Arguments:
  project            project slug or directory
  run                run id (folder under runs/), run directory, or "latest"

Options:
  --scenario <name>  with "latest": the latest run of this scenario
  --format <format>  mp4 (H.264 high profile, CRF 14, yuv420p) or prores (ProRes
                     422 HQ .mov); default mp4 or project raw.format (choices:
                     "mp4", "prores")
  --fps <n>          30 or 60 (real frame timing, never interpolated); default
                     30 (choices: "30", "60")
  --cursor <mode>    baked (as captured), none (run captured with run --raw
                     --cursor none) or layer (a transparent cursor video per
                     clip); default: as captured (choices: "baked", "none",
                     "layer")
  --layer <format>   cursor layer codec: prores (ProRes 4444) or webm (VP9
                     alpha); default prores (choices: "prores", "webm")
  --selects          also one continuous selects file of the clips
  --no-cuts          keep the loading inside scenes (page loads before a scene
                     are never in a clip)
  --out <dir>        package folder (default
                     exports/<run>-raw-<format><fps>-<cursor>/)
  --json             print the package manifest as JSON
  --no-wait          start at once even while a take films on this Mac (default:
                     wait for it, then go on at background priority during later
                     takes)
  -h, --help         display help for command
